[SWS_DM_00898] ClearDTC call on invalid DTC or DTC group
⌈
If
the
function
Clear()
of
the
ara::diag::DTCInformation
instance
([SWS_DM_00671]) is called and the parameter DTCGroup of the function Clear()
has no matching configured DTC group according to [SWS_DM_00064] or configured
DTC by DiagnosticTroubleCodeUds.udsDtcValue, the DM shall trigger the error
kWrongDtc for that function call and the DM shall return without any further action.
⌋
